newsitem.title: UK: UK's Reunion unit bags two diamond licenses.
newsitem.headline: UK's Reunion unit bags two diamond licenses.

text.p: Britain's Reunion Mining Plc said on Monday that one of its subsidiaries, Reunion Mining Botswana Ltd, had been awarded two exploration licences for diamonds in north-west Botswana.
The licences cover over 30 magnetic anomalies discovered by a recent airborne survey.
Both licences together cover 1,990 square km and comprise the Tsodilo diamond exploration project.
Botswana is the largest producer of gem-quality diamonds in the world.
Reunion's exploration licences are valid for three years, renewable for a further two periods of two years each with 50 percent area reductions on each renewal, the company said.
